headline: Panoší Újezd Summer House / Lenka Milerová architektka
context: Mrs. F. owned a large house in the village of Panoší Újezd . It had become too big for her, so she decided to keep only the old pigsty and a small patch of garden from the entire property, which she wanted to convert into a summer home. The building was in a disastrous state.
